Through the series, G.I. Joe: Sigma 6, Jinx is only a reserve member of the Sigma 6 team. It is more apparent in the series that she is an elder student over Kamakura whom she is often partnered with.

page.overview:
Who is Jinx?

Through the series, G.I. Joe: Sigma 6, Jinx is only a reserve member of the Sigma 6 team. It is more apparent in the series that she is an elder student over Kamakura whom she is often partnered with.
